video_title: Andre Iguodala joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of self-deprecation for former athletes
quotes.excerpt: being a former athlete, self-deprecation is pretty natural.
quotes.quote: Being a former athlete, self-deprecation is pretty natural. So, I don't really care about the stuff on the court as much.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on being a self-taught shooter throughout his career
quotes.excerpt: I was a self-taught shooter, so I made a thousand threes without being a shooter.
quotes.quote: I was a self-taught shooter, so I made a thousand threes without being a shooter. I used the Kobe method where I just shot 500 makes a day. But the form piece, I was never equipped with the proper player development system.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the lack of proper player development in his early career
quotes.excerpt: I was never equipped with the proper player development system. My entire first eight years of my career.
quotes.quote: I was never equipped with the proper player development system. My entire first eight years of my career. I didn't know I probably should have went to a high school and got access to a gym. I thought like, you always have access to a gym, but then, as I got older, I always got my reps up, but I didn't know like, oh, I could have went to the gym at night.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on taking pride in his defensive contributions
quotes.excerpt: I was really good at defense. That's the only thing I would say I was really good at.
quotes.quote: I was really good at defense. That's the only thing I would say I was really good at. I was like one of the top defenders.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the mental challenge of retiring from professional sports
quotes.excerpt: They say you die when you retire. Athletes die twice.
quotes.quote: They say you die when you retire. Athletes die twice. Sometimes when I'm working on something else and I'm struggling because there's just not my first area of expertise and I'm still learning, I have to go remind myself like, oh, I had a brain at one point that worked.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of leadership and team relationships
quotes.excerpt: I think it's leadership. And not like leadership raw-raw being loud. I knew my teammates.
quotes.quote: I think it's leadership. And not like leadership raw-raw being loud. I knew my teammates. And so I had a relationship with all of them. My teammates always like, yo, yo, I want to go in the game with you.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his mindset during the 2015 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I thought I was the best player in the league in the series. I knew I wasn't.
quotes.quote: I thought I was the best player in the league in the series. I knew I wasn't, but I thought I was. That's the mindset. Like, we all know LeBron is LeBron. I told LeBron this one time and this was like, career's over. I said, listen man, you are one of the best basketball players of all time, you are one of my favorite players, but I could not allow myself to ever say that or ever even think it. But I'm telling you right now.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his confidence during the 2015 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I'm the best player on the court. I didn't think I was going to miss every time I got the ball.
quotes.quote: I'm the best player on the court. I didn't think I was going to miss every time I got the ball. That's probably the highest confidence I've ever been.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of values in business and sports
quotes.excerpt: We drive our value while we play. And then once you're done playing, they're kicking your ass.
quotes.quote: We drive our value while we play. And then once you're done playing, they're kicking your ass and shut the door.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his role in the Warriors' championship run
quotes.excerpt: Hopefully, you know, I can be that piece to get the team to where we all want.
quotes.quote: Hopefully, you know, I can be that piece to get the team to where we all want to be, which is try to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on his relationship with Kiki Vandeweghe
quotes.excerpt: Before I even won Finals MVP, I hugged Kiki Vandeweghe, who might have been the most hated guy.
quotes.quote: Before I even won Finals MVP, I hugged Kiki Vandeweghe, who might have been the most hated guy amongst players at that time.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of the 'stamp of approval'
quotes.excerpt: Stamp of approval. Now you can't say it with approval because that's not one word.
quotes.quote: Stamp of approval. Now you can't say it with approval because that's not one word.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of shooting form
quotes.excerpt: I told my son, don't shoot like Steph, shoot like Klay.
quotes.quote: I told my son, don't shoot like Steph, shoot like Klay. No, I know you can't shoot like Steph. No one can shoot like Steph. But if you're trying to form your shot, it's Klay.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the difficulty of being a professional athlete
quotes.excerpt: We would switch places with them any day of the week.
quotes.quote: We would switch places with them any day of the week. They can have the fame, they can have pulling up to the club, getting the table, not having to get a reservation. You can have that.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the challenges of being a professional athlete
quotes.excerpt: I can't go through airports. It's the worst.
quotes.quote: I can't go through airports. It's the worst.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the competitiveness of the 2016 Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Steph and I were actually teammates on the World Championship team. His ankles weren't attached yet.
quotes.quote: Steph and I were actually teammates on the World Championship team. His ankles weren't attached yet. They were still falling off the bone.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the physical demands of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Steph plays taller than he actually is and he's actually stronger than people think.
quotes.quote: Steph plays taller than he actually is and he's actually stronger than people think, so he can actually defend. But when you got Russ who plays like he's 6'8, then you had Roberson who's 6'8, KD at the three, he's 7 feet tall, Ibaka is 6'10, and then Stephen Adams is the strongest human on earth.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the impact of Andrew Bogut's injury
quotes.excerpt: Bogut goes down first half. Nobody talks about that.
quotes.quote: Bogut goes down first half. Nobody talks about that. He was out for the series.

quotes.speaker: Andre Iguodala
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Iguodala on the importance of humility in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: You got to be crazy to arrive at a moment in the Finals because guys break.
quotes.quote: You got to be crazy to arrive at a moment in the Finals because guys break. And that's all here. It's like, what's the word? You ain't going to die.
